cues: Welcome to Class 12 Physics, Unit 15: Thermoelectric Effects.
At the junction of two different metals, heat and electricity are directly linked.
A temperature difference makes a voltage, and a current makes a temperature difference.
These effects run every industrial thermocouple, every thermopile, and the little solid state coolers in portable fridges.
